compass: Real-VIX unified tri-scope conditional scenario generator
hypothesis: A 719a-style state-aware normalized-innovation framework can be rerun as one frozen recipe across IV-only, observed-anchor-only, and joint IV+anchor scopes after replacing the IV-derived VIX proxy with observed Yahoo ^VIX.
prediction_L3: The same generative core should preserve IV realism, anchor realism, joint co-movement, and population risk-state conditional response. Remaining defects, if any, should concentrate in calibration and sticky low-activity credit-spread channels rather than requiring separate IV/anchor mechanisms.
kill_gate: Do not claim a publishable single framework if the recipe only works by changing loss weights, backend, sampler, calibration layer, or stochastic source across scopes. If AAA/BBB OAS stickiness remains the only serious issue, either document it as a limitation or test one generic low-activity-channel adapter.
warm_start: 719a methodology baseline, not a real-VIX checkpoint
baseline: pre-real-VIX 719a family; real-VIX tri-scope champion not yet established
